actions.action: Rinse leaves gently with plain water and wipe with soft damp cloth
Slide plant out of pot and check roots and soil
Adjust watering, letting top 1-2 inches of soil dry between waterings
Inspect leaf joints, undersides and stem base for pests with bright light and magnifier
If cottony masses found, dab them with alcohol-dipped cotton swab
Review environment (light, humidity, temperature, drafts) and adjust
Take and share photos of roots and stem base

reason: The answer says there is no active infestation and blames spray residue and watering, when the confirmed problem was a whitefly-type infestation; it also tells the owner to stop the alcohol treatment that actually cleared the bugs, which would delay the fix.
